strategyFamily: four-sleeve funding-regime spot-perpetual carry with high collateral and causal risk re-anchoring
motivation: Trial 19 provided positive development evidence for a causal funding-regime filter (positive basket return, Sharpe above 1, shallow drawdown, four completed round trips) but failed only the frozen extreme isolated-margin gap-stress gate. Trial 22 prospectively tests whether the same carry idea can retain positive economics while making the margin design structurally robust. It uses a fresh derivative information set, lower venue-native friction already frozen independently in Trial 20, 80% sleeve collateral while active, and causal re-anchoring before notional drift can dominate isolated margin. No Trial 22 LINK/BCH/EOS/UNI funding, perpetual, basis, or carry economics are queried before this freeze.

assetSelection.rule: Use four longstanding liquid members of the project's pre-existing historical crypto universe that are not used as derivative/carry test assets in Trials 17-21. Selection is frozen before Trial 22 derivative acquisition and does not use Trial 22 funding or basis outcomes.

dataPreviouslyObservedAtFreeze.interpretation: Trial 22 is a fresh derivative/carry replication, not a pristine spot-price-path test.

portfolio.position: when active, long spot and short exactly equal coin units of the matching Binance USD-M perpetual
portfolio.reanchorSizing: after a prescribed re-anchor, close both legs and immediately reopen at the same boundary with spot notional equal to 15% and futures collateral equal to 80% of then-current sleeve equity

signal.causality: At boundary t the funding-state decision uses exactly the preceding 90 realized funding observations ending at t-1; current-boundary funding is excluded from the signal. A newly entered position receives no funding at its entry boundary. An already-open position receives the current-boundary funding payment before any signal exit or re-anchor executed at that boundary.
signal.thresholdRationale: The entry hurdle is frozen from transaction-cost economics under the independently frozen Trial 20 venue-native cost model: 15% annualized funding materially exceeds the approximate combined two-leg round-trip friction over a multi-month opportunity while remaining less selective than Trial 19's 20% hurdle. The 5% exit threshold supplies hysteresis. No LINK/BCH/EOS/UNI funding history informed either threshold.

riskControl.reanchorAction: If the funding exit condition is not met but either the 60-day age cap or the 25%-of-current-equity mark-notional cap is reached, close and immediately reopen both legs at that boundary using the frozen 15% spot / 80% collateral sizing. Funding for an already-open position at that boundary is credited before the re-anchor. Re-anchor costs are fully charged.
riskControl.realizedMarginOrdering: The existing position is first tested for realized isolated-margin maintenance at the observed current mark. Only if it remains solvent may the strategy exit or re-anchor. Frozen hypothetical gap stresses are evaluated on the position retained after the boundary decision.
riskControl.rationale: Trial 19 showed that static coin units can make isolated perpetual notional grow relative to a fixed collateral reserve even when the spot hedge keeps total economic exposure close to neutral. High collateral plus deterministic re-anchoring addresses that mechanical margin path rather than changing the carry signal after seeing Trial 22 outcomes.

costModel.inheritance: Directly inherited from already-frozen Trial 20 venue-native research assumptions; Trial 22 outcomes did not inform these values.

finalHoldout.accessRule: No Trial 22 final derivative/funding row may be acquired unless the frozen development gate passes.

dataRequirements.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY spot 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualExecution: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M standard 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualMark: checksum-verified union of MONTHLY and DAILY USD-M 8h markPriceKlines with exact overlap agreement
dataRequirements.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M fundingRate archives

developmentGate.decision: Every criterion must pass before final-holdout acquisition. Failure freezes Trial 22 without final access or in-place rescue.

promotionCriteria.decision: Every criterion must pass. Passing authorizes a separate paper-baseline promotion proposal only; never real-money trading.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 22 development economic output, no asset, threshold, lookback, hysteresis, minimum state duration, sizing, collateral, re-anchor rule, date, cost, source rule, entry/exit accounting, stress, or gate may change under Trial 22.
